segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Simulirajte evoluciju pomoću agenata koji traže hranu, razmnožavaju se i prenose mutirajuće gene. Pregledajte pojedine agente te analizirajte populaciju i raspodjelu gena na grafikonima.
